_comment: Who the salvager was before the line snapped. Chosen on the new-game page. Each gives a small start (effects use the rule language) and sets flag origin_<id>, which a few residents notice. 'after' finishes the epilogue sentence about you.

hauler.name: Line hauler
hauler.blurb: You hauled cable for a salvage crew. You know knots, and how to keep walking.
hauler.after: and nobody in Wick ever again tied a knot that came undone

seedkeeper.name: Seed-keeper
seedkeeper.blurb: You kept a seed-box on a rooftop farm. You brought some of it down with you, in your coat.
seedkeeper.after: and the seed-box from the roof is still in Hesper's hut, planted

runner.name: Scrip-runner
runner.blurb: You ran messages and money between market towns. You talk quickly and count quicker.
runner.after: and Odile still says you were the only honest courier she ever met, and then counts her change

medic.name: Field medic
medic.blurb: You patched up salvagers on the surface. You notice coughs, and you notice people hiding them.
medic.after: and the children of Wick were checked for coughs every damp season, gently, by someone who'd learned how

wanderer.name: Nobody in particular
wanderer.blurb: You were going somewhere else when the ground opened. You've been going somewhere else for years.
wanderer.after: and stopped, for once, and stayed stopped
